evidence.quote: The patient' s individual or family, if applicable, income is at or below 200% of the current Federal Poverty Income Guidelines for a 100% CCP discount.

tiers.description: 67% CCP discount for income 201%-400% of FPL; charges limited to AGB for eligible patients.

evidence.quote: The patient's individual or family, if applicable, income is 201%-400% of the current Federal Poverty Income Guidelines for a 67% CCP discount.

asset_test.details: Policy body does not clearly state an asset test. The plain language summary lists a bank statement as needed to apply and the application asks for asset verification, but NHSC clinics are stated to not require asset testing.

evidence.quote: NHSC certified Clinics: "Asset testing is not required for financial assistance for NHSC facilities.

residency.area: Ohio counties: Adams, Athens, Clinton, Fayette, Gallia, Green, Highland, Hocking, Jackson, Madison, Pickaway, Pike, Ross, Scioto, Vinton (for CCP); HCAP requires Ohio residence; NHSC clinics exempt from county limits

evidence.quote: At the time of service, the patient resides, with the intent to remain, in one of the following fifteen Ohio counties: Adams, Athens, Clinton, Fayette, Gallia, Green, Highland, Hocking, Jackson, Madison, Pickaway, Pike, Ross, Scioto, or Vinton
Applications for CCP assistance will be accepted for a period of 240 days from the first follow-up notice for payment sent to the patient.

how_to_apply: Call 855-275-7408 or (740) 779-8786; email FinancialCounselingTeam@adena.org; mail to Adena Health System, Financial Counselor, 272 Hospital Rd Suite 240, Chillicothe, OH 45601; fax 740-779-8257; www.adena.org
warnings: Policy requires patients who may be Medicaid-eligible to apply for Medicaid and be denied to receive CCP assistance; plain language summary says you cannot be a Medicaid recipient. Insured eligibility is not clearly stated.
HCAP (income below 100% FPL, Ohio residents) gives a 100% discount; the CCP free-care limit is 200% FPL.
Application deadline for HCAP is three years from date of service; the 240-day CCP window runs from the first follow-up notice for payment.
Dollar income table in the plain language summary is labeled with FPL percentages; the table labels 201-300% and 301-400% both as 67%.
Asset treatment is ambiguous: summary requires a bank statement, NHSC clinics exempt from asset testing.
Policy expiration 05/2022; the plain language summary says income must be less than 400% FPL, while the body says 201%-400%.
